## Example 4.1 · Semi-annual compounding {#fm4-example-4-1-b .fm-slide }

Find the total value of an investment if \$8000 is invested at

b) 5% p.a. compounded semi-annually for 4 years

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 10–11 · Example 4.1 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
$r=5/2=2.5$, $n=8$. $A=8000(1+0.05/2)^8\approx\$9747.22$. Keep all calculator precision until the final amount.
:::
